the H. pylori babAB genotypes correlate with different clinical disease outcomes in different gastric niches.

the variable genotypes of H. pylori babA and bab B may correlate with different gastric diseases and topographic distribution.
H. pylori clinical strains have diverse babAB genotypes in the stomach with correlation to different clinical disease outcome and topographic distribution.
the variable genotypes of the babA/B genes are associated with different clinical disease outcomes in patients with gastric diseases.

H. pylori isolates with different babA and babA genotypes may have distinct clinical outcomes.
babAB genotype distribution over different gastric niches may be related to clinical disease outcomes.
the variable genotype of babAB may help H. pyloir to colonize in different niches of stomach and to cause different clinical outcomes.
